rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs accredited by CMA, AMA or ACCME that qualify for AMA PRA Category 1 Credit; AAFP prescribed credit; other programs acceptable to the Board. Also: 6 hours per month of ACGME residency/fellowship; teaching a CME course (max one-third of hours); passing a specialty board (re)certification exam = 100 hours for four consecutive years
rules.alternatives: CME waiver possible for health, military service or undue hardship (not after an audit); if denied, renew once and document 100 hours by the end of the next cycle. Retired and inactive status renewals need no CME.
rules.audit_note: Certification under penalty of perjury at renewal; annual audit required by law. Keep CME records at least 4 years. The Board can verify credits reported by ACCME providers in PARS.

topics.who: All except pathologists and radiologists: 12 hours in pain management and treatment of terminally ill and dying patients (any split), incl. risks of addiction with Schedule II drugs; by the second renewal. Alternative: one-time 12-hour opiate-dependent patient course incl. 8 h buprenorphine treatment
Part of the same one-time 12-hour pain management / terminally ill and dying patients requirement; pathologists and radiologists exempt
General internists and family physicians with over 25% of patients aged 65+: at least 20% of mandatory CME in geriatric medicine, care of older patients or dementia care

rules.notes: Licenses expire every two years on the last day of the month in which they were issued; no grace period. The 12 one-time hours count toward the 50. Renewal fee includes $25 Thompson program and $30 CURES fees.
rules.legal_basis: Business and Professions Code section 2423; Cal. Code of Regulations Title 16 sections 1336, 1338
rules.rule_quote: To ensure the continuing competence as a licensed physician, you must complete a minimum of 50 hours of approved Continuing Medical Education (CME) hours during each biennial renewal cycle.

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 hours AOA Category 1A or 1B; remainder may be other Board-approved CME (AMA-listed CME counts as AOA Category 2; journal reading 0.5 Category 2 per journal; practice management content max 30%)
rules.alternatives: Board may waive requirements under special circumstances (application required). CME waived proportionally for time spent in residency or fellowship during the cycle.
rules.audit_note: CME is checked in random audits after the renewal period; proof (AOA activity report or certificates, PDF only) sent only on request. Failure can lead to citation and fine.

topics.who: All DOs: risks of addiction associated with Schedule II drugs / opioids, every renewal

All except pathology and radiology specialists (licensed on or after January 1, 2002): pain management and treatment of terminally ill and dying patients, within 4 years of licensure or by the second renewal, whichever comes first. Alternative: 12-hour opiate-dependent patient course incl. 8 h buprenorphine
All except pathology and radiology specialists: part of the same one-time 12-hour pain management / terminally ill patients requirement

rules.notes: DOs are licensed by the separate Osteopathic Medical Board of California (ombc.ca.gov). CME period equals the 2-year renewal period. All CME must include implicit bias curriculum (BPC 2190.1), a provider-side rule without set hours.
rules.legal_basis: BPC § 2454.5; Cal. Code of Regulations Title 16 sections 1635, 1636, 1638, 1641, 1646, 1659.30-1659.35
rules.rule_quote: b) A physician shall complete 50 credit hours within the two-year period.
